description: Is this crypto firm authorised under MiCA in the EU? One call checks the official ESMA register of crypto-asset service providers (CASP) by company name or LEI: authorised or not, home member state, competent authority, authorisation date, the exact services it may provide, and the countries it passports to. Query: ?name=Bitpanda or ?lei=5493007WZ7IFULIL8G21 — $0.010000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "is this crypto exchange licensed in the eu", "mica authorisation check", "check a crypto firm with esma".
name: eu_mica-check
